method: All48 complete rendered turns, decisions, expected useful claims, citations, resource links, strict verdicts and failure details compared with fully reviewed report22 and are identical. Frozen oracles unchanged.
qualification: Observed regression conversations, not unseen evaluation. One useful claim uses an alternative literal guide helper and has a stated judgment qualification.
